'''''Cryptanthus''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Bromeliaceae]], subfamily [[Bromelioideae]]. The genus name is from the Greek ''cryptos'' (hidden) and ''anthos'' (flower). The genus formerly had two recognized subgenera: the type subgenus and subgenus ''Hoplocryptanthus'' <small>Mez</small> which has been raised to the separate genus ''[[Hoplocryptanthus]]''.<ref name=EOB/> All [[species]] of this genus are [[Endemism|endemic]] to [[Brazil]].<ref name=POWO_4910-1/><ref name=Mart08/> The common name for any ''Cryptanthus'' is "Earth star".<ref name=BI/>

==Former species==
A major revision of ''Cryptanthus'' in 2017 based on both morphological and molecular characters elevated a former subgenus to the genus ''[[Hoplocryptanthus]]'' and created two new genera, ''[[Forzzaea]]'' and ''[[Rokautskyia]]'', transferring many former ''Cryptanthus'' species to these three genera.<ref name=LemeHellZizkHalb17/>

===Transferred to ''Forzzaea''===
*''Cryptanthus leopoldo-horstii'' <small>Rauh</small> → ''[[Forzzaea leopoldo-horstii]]'' <small>(Rauh) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka</small>
*''Cryptanthus micrus'' <small>Louzada, Wand. & Versieux</small> → ''[[Forzzaea micra]]'' <small>(Louzada, Wand. & Versieux) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka</small>
*''Cryptanthus warasii'' <small>E.Pereira</small> → ''[[Forzzaea warasii]]'' <small>(E.Pereira) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka</small>

===Transferred to ''Haplocryptanthus''===
*''Cryptanthus caracensis'' <small>Leme & E.Gross</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus caracensis]]'' {{small|(Leme & E.Gross) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
*''Cryptanthus ferrarius'' <small>Leme & C.C.Paula</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus ferrarius]]'' {{small|(Leme & C.C.Paula) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
*''Cryptanthus glaziovii'' <small>Mez</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus glaziovii]]'' {{small|(Mez) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
*''Cryptanthus lavrasensis'' <small>Leme</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus lavrasensis]]'' {{small|(Leme) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
*''Cryptanthus regius'' <small>Leme</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus regius]]'' {{small|(Leme) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
*''Cryptanthus schwackeanus'' <small>Mez</small> → ''[[Hoplocryptanthus schwackeanus]]'' {{small|(Mez) Leme, S.Heller & Zizka}}
